act_title: The Marine Products Export Development Authority Act, 1972
title: Application, cancellation, fee payable and other matters relating to registration
text:
12. Application, cancellation, fee payable and other matters relating to registration.—The form of

application for registration under section 11 and for the cancellation of such registration, the fee payable on
such applications, the particulars to be included in such applications, the procedure to be followed in
granting and cancelling registration and the registers to be kept by the Authority shall be such as may be
prescribed.

6
